data.long_meaning: The name Jackelyn is derived from the Old English name Jack, meaning God is gracious, and the Cornish name Ellyn, meaning wave or the elven one. The combination of these names results in a name that symbolizes the grace of God and the power of the waves. The name Jackelyn carries the meaning “God is gracious” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Jackelyn usually hope their child will grow to embody god is gracious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
